name: kubora
description: Find self-storage near you: storage units, container parks and garages by city, postal code or address, with unit sizes, monthly prices and access hours, and the link to each location's page on Kubora.

interface.longDescription:
Find self-storage near you: storage units, container parks and garages by city, postal code or address, with unit sizes, monthly prices and access hours, and the link to each location's page on Kubora.

Ask in your own words: a 5 m² storage unit in Berlin under 100 euros, a garage near 80331 Munich, self storage within 10 km of Cologne. The answer lists the matching locations with operator, address, access hours, the lowest monthly price with its date and the distance from the place you named.

What you can do:
- Find self-storage (Selfstorage, Lagerraum, Lagerbox), container parks and garages in a city or around a postal code, an address or coordinates.
- Filter by type of storage, unit size in square metres and monthly price.
- Open one location: operator, address, access hours per weekday, amenities and every bookable unit size with its price.
- Get the link to the location's page to compare and send an enquiry.

How it works: no account and no sign-in. Only the public catalog of kubora.de is read. Prices are the ones the site shows, each with its date; the price at booking is binding. Nothing is booked, changed or saved on your behalf.

The catalog and this app are operated by EasyWeek GmbH, Düsseldorf, Germany.
capabilities: Find self-storage, container parks and garages in a city or near a postal code
Filter by type of storage, unit size and monthly price
Compare locations by distance, access hours and lowest monthly price
See every bookable unit size of a location with its monthly price
Get the location's page on Kubora to send an enquiry
defaultPrompt: Storage of about 5 m² near 80331 under 120 euros

positive.expected_behavior: Lists storage locations in Berlin with operator, address, access hours and the lowest monthly price with its date where published, each with its kubora.de link; nothing is booked.

positive.description: Filter by size and price around a postal code.
positive.prompt: I need about 5 m² of storage near 80331 for under 120 euros a month.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the nearest locations around Munich 80331 with a unit of about 5 m² at or under 120 euros a month, with the distance and the matching units, and says how many nearby locations publish no prices.

positive.description: Search one type of storage within a radius.
positive.prompt: Which garages can I rent within 15 km of Cologne?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists garage locations within 15 km of Cologne sorted by distance, with address and kubora.de link.

positive.prompt: Show all unit sizes and monthly prices of a self-storage location in Munich that has a unit under 100 euros.
positive.expected_behavior: Picks a Munich location with a unit under 100 euros a month and returns its operator, address, access hours where stated and every bookable size with its monthly price and the date of the prices, plus its kubora.de link.

positive.description: A small town the catalog has no city page for.
positive.prompt: Is there any storage near Tegernsee?
positive.expected_behavior: Locates Tegernsee by its postal code and lists the nearest storage locations with their distance in kilometres.

negative.description: No contract actions; the app only reads public listings.
negative.prompt: Cancel my storage contract with my current provider.
negative.expected_behavior: The app is not invoked: it searches public storage listings and has no access to anyone's rental contract.

negative.description: No locations are invented where the catalog has none.
negative.expected_behavior: The app finds no listed storage there and the assistant says so instead of inventing locations; the catalog currently lists locations in Germany.

negative.description: Do not trigger for a request outside the product.
negative.prompt: What is the weather in Hamburg this weekend?
negative.expected_behavior: The app is not invoked: it finds storage locations and knows nothing about the weather.

review.commerce_description: The app takes no payment and sells nothing; renting a unit happens with the operator after an enquiry on kubora.de.

publication.release_notes: 1.0.1: publisher named as EasyWeek GmbH; two read-only tools: search_storage and get_location.

de-DE.subtitle: Selfstorage in deiner Nähe
de-DE.description:
Finde Selfstorage in deiner Nähe: Lagerräume, Containerparks und Garagen nach Stadt, Postleitzahl oder Adresse, mit Größen, Monatspreisen und Zugangszeiten und dem Link zur Seite jedes Standorts auf Kubora.

Frag einfach in deinen Worten: ein Lagerraum mit 5 m² in Berlin unter 100 Euro, eine Garage bei 80331 München, Selfstorage im Umkreis von 10 km um Köln. Die Antwort nennt passende Standorte mit Anbieter, Adresse, Zugangszeiten, dem günstigsten Monatspreis mit Datum und der Entfernung zum genannten Ort.

Was du tun kannst:
- Selfstorage, Lagerraum, Lagerbox, Containerpark oder Garage in einer Stadt finden oder rund um eine Postleitzahl, eine Adresse oder Koordinaten.
- Nach Art des Lagers, Größe in Quadratmetern und Monatspreis filtern.
- Einen Standort im Detail öffnen: Anbieter, Adresse, Zugangszeiten je Wochentag, Ausstattung und jede buchbare Größe mit Preis.
- Den Link zur Seite des Standorts öffnen, um zu vergleichen und eine Anfrage zu senden.

So funktioniert es: kein Konto, keine Anmeldung. Gelesen wird nur der öffentliche Katalog von kubora.de. Die Preise sind die der Website, jeweils mit Datum; verbindlich ist der Preis bei der Buchung. Nichts wird für dich gebucht, geändert oder gespeichert.

Katalog und App werden von der EasyWeek GmbH in Düsseldorf betrieben.
